spans.s:
Ādāra was a kind of plant which was prescribed as a substitute for soma. It is identified in the Śatapatha brāhmaṇa with pūtīka.
Foot notes Satapatha brāhmaṇa, iv. 5, 10, 4.
xiv. 1, 2, 12. Cf. Kāthaka Saṃhitā, xxiv. 3; Kātyāyana śrauta sūtra, xxv. 12, 19.
Cf. Zimmer, Altindisches Leben, 276.
